priorityList: Use offensive trinkets and potions when Avenging Wrath or Radiant Glory is active.
Cast Avenging Wrath (or Radiant Glory) on cooldown, but ensure Expurgation is ticking first if talented into Holy Flames.
Cast Execution Sentence if Wake of Ashes is ready to be used.
Cast Hammer of Light whenever it is available (triggered after using Wake of Ashes).
Spend Holy Power on Templar's Verdict (or Final Verdict) if you are at 5 Holy Power or if a free Hammer of Light proc is about to expire.
Cast Wake of Ashes if Avenging Wrath is active or soon ready, and you are not at max Holy Power.
Cast Divine Toll on cooldown, ideally while Avenging Wrath is active.
Cast Hammer of Wrath whenever it is available (during Avenging Wrath or on targets below 20% health).
Cast Divine Storm only if you have an Empyrean Power proc.
Cast Blade of Justice if Art of War or Righteous Cause procs.
Spend Holy Power on Templar's Verdict (or Final Verdict) if you have 3 or more Holy Power.
Cast Blade of Justice to generate Holy Power and maintain the Expurgation dot.
Cast Judgment to generate Holy Power.
Use Templar Strike, Templar Slash, or Crusader Strike as a filler to generate Holy Power.
Use Arcane Torrent if you need Holy Power and all other generators are on cooldown.
